name: Terrarium 35x25x20 +3D
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 35x25x20 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 17.5 liters, horizontal format. The large floor area makes it ideal for ground-dwelling species. Handmade in Novi Sad.
imageAlt: Glass terrarium 35x25x20 cm with 3D background - NS Reptiles

description.html: This model is lower than it is wide: 35x25 cm of floor and 20 cm of height, with 17.5 liters of volume. The 875 cm² floor is larger than on the 35x20x25 model of the same volume. That makes it a terrarium for ground-dwelling species. The ventilation is mesh, and the background is 3D, made of styrofoam.

A young leopard gecko gets a warm and a cool hide here, some fifteen centimeters apart, with a water dish between them. A young corn snake is not bothered by the low ceiling, because it moves along the floor and slips under the decor. For crested and day geckos 20 cm of height is too little, so this model serves them only briefly, as a rearing box.

The taller variant of the same floor is the 35x25x28 without a background or the 35x25x30 with a 3D background. You choose the background relief, rock or bark, when ordering. Building a model to your dimensions takes 7 to 14 days. Film goes on the outside of the sides and back, so a juvenile has cover on three sides.
